description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Migrate the project to Java 25, the latest LTS release, to benefit from modern language features, performance improvements, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 25. Update build files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to set the Java source and target compatibility to 25. Resolve any compilation errors or deprecation issues introduced by the Java 25 migration. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25 by updating <java.version> in pom.xml. JDK 25 (Temurin 25.0.3) was available on the build machine. Maven compiled cleanly with no source code changes required. All tests passed.
